observations: Over-the-shoulder view from behind Ananya as she faces screen-right toward a silver laptop at three-quarter view. Low bun with loose strands, gold stud, and a calm smiling profile with almond eye and level brow are visible, matching main-cast.png.

Wording mismatch, not a defect: geometrically the camera is behind her LEFT shoulder (her left ear and shoulder face the reader), while the scene and camera fields say 'right shoulder'. The intended read (back view, profile, bun, stud, typing) is fully achieved and her hands are correct, so I am not raising an issue. You may want to correct the scene wording.
Both hands type on the keyboard with teal kurta cuffs showing under the white coat sleeves, as production specifies. The fingers rest naturally on the keys.
The laptop screen is text-free: a three-dot progress indicator, rounded blank fields (one active with only a cursor bar), blue blocks and a teal button. No words, logos or numbers.
A mug sits on a cork coaster. A dusk window with a pink-orange sky gives the evening light. Binders and a plant are at left. The time and place change from 01-3's daytime reception is clear.

Flat white rectangles are left at top-left and top-right (the right one cuts across the window frame) for the caption and the 'WELBUK PRACTICE' label at x=682. In bare art they look artificial. Whether the lettering fully covers them must be confirmed at lettering, not certified here.
No stethoscope tubing is visible from this back angle. The collar plausibly hides it and 02-2 shows the stethoscope, so this is not a defect.
